boss_encounter_roles.zekarion: fixed marks, held conducting lane, advancing claw and capped wisps
boss_encounter_roles.tharokh: capped attackable Worldspines, open approach routes and delayed rupture
boss_encounter_roles.vyraketh: shared Fire setup and deniable telegraphed detonation
boss_encounter_roles.vaeloryx: held directional displacement, advancing dive and retreat
boss_encounter_roles.iskaldra: capped hit-count armor, held Ice lane, physical sweep and pursuit
boss_encounter_roles.noctyrax: Eclipse outside lit refuges, held attacks and alternating brazier snuff

guardian_encounters.map: one optional named Guardian in each section, replacing a middle-group combat; 66 rooms and 40 fight opportunities remain
guardian_encounters.roster: one 36–44 HP bespoke leader plus one or two 4–6 HP helpers; all have 1x1 footprints
guardian_encounters.clock: Roc and Cantor initiative 20 plus Time 4–7; their helpers initiative 19 plus Time 4; other Guardians retain initiative 9–12 and helpers 8–10; ordinary Wisp remains 7 plus 4
guardian_encounters.telegraphs: authored directional patterns hold orientation and relative approach; displacement and surviving interrupted approaches reanchor their footprint; ordinary attacks use live targets; skipped slots advance
guardian_encounters.cohort_pressure: helpers advance on each intent and prefer complementary safe flanks; one missing roster helper can be announced per Guardian activation, at most two alive; summons avoid the acting Guardian destination and its attack tiles, prefer valid reservations, and relocate occupied reservations within summon range
guardian_encounters.ground_pressure: Reaver marks up to nine Fire tiles and adds Fire after empty sword strikes; Cantor and Tender extend a shared conductive network; Craghide outcrops threaten radius two
guardian_encounters.scaling: ordinary local HP factors and completed-section HP/damage/support curves; no generic leader multiplier
guardian_encounters.rewards: six exclusive run-long trophies; original non-summoned helpers grant one player-card defeat play; all summoned replacements and original Wisps/Shades grant none; helpers grant zero Embers
guardian_encounters.geometry: shared outcrops block movement and attack sight; Craghide cannot disconnect floor routes; player outcrops may block routes and normal obstacle-clearing AI applies
guardian_encounters.ground_targeting: surface-producing attacks admit legal empty floor; a preceding attack can share Fire ground with previous-target Detonate; damage still requires an occupant and no extra fuel is assumed
guardian_encounters.card_score_policy: optional encounter cohort and owned-relic synergies are excluded from intrinsic printed-card scores

trophy_curves.ashen_brand: D * (1 + .25 * (maximum overlapping crosses - 1)), round once halves up; one hit per actor
trophy_curves.resonant_clapper: D * (1 + .25 * enemy hop), round once halves up; native heads start at zero and empty relays/conduction do not advance it
trophy_curves.winters_spur: one base Move per straight Ice segment; corners and leaving Ice restart cost, Rubble surcharge remains
trophy_curves.galehook_talon: up to N * F enemy-steps for N contiguous collinear enemies and printed force F; blocked/contact-interrupted groups stop together
trophy_curves.cragbound_gauntlet: ranged Earth spells create one 3-HP outcrop at an empty chosen center; no separate Move or Stoneskin cost; occupied targets stay ordinary spell hits
trophy_curves.procession_lantern: existing Illusion movement consumes the same independent Move as the hero; no added HP, vision, or card target

large_enemy_targeting: one legal visible footprint tile makes the actor's full footprint clickable; still one target and one hit

roles.frontliner: close distance and convert reachable attacks
roles.artillery: hold useful range and establish legal shots
roles.skirmisher: kite at close range and advance only to establish pressure
roles.protector: guard exposed allies or advance to screen the back line
roles.controller: establish range for control and pressure actions
roles.support: heal or guard relevant allies and avoid unnecessary melee pursuit

enemy_tactical_ai.selection: reject tactically dead intents, then retain seeded weighted variation among near-best legal choices
enemy_tactical_ai.path_tie_break: true total cost first; equal routes prefer strongest immediate current-activation progress
enemy_tactical_ai.score_policy: raises realized encounter pressure without changing intrinsic printed-card coefficients

warden_bulwark: grants scaled Block to every other living enemy and never to the acting Warden

player_flow.movement_timing: may be split before, between, or after printed card plays without spending a play or initiative Time
player_flow.movement_score_policy: turn-shared positioning context; do not add it to every card's intrinsic reach or movement value

combat_objectives.score_policy: keep intrinsic coefficients neutral; compare movement, control, AOE, and execute results by objective_type analytics cohort

qualitative_progression.coefficient_policy: exclude skill effects from intrinsic printed-card scores

defiance.score_policy: exclude Defiance from intrinsic printed-card scores

board_surfaces.chill_timing: actual entry or eligible actor activation start
board_surfaces.freeze_cost: consume all Ice under the successfully Frozen actor
board_surfaces.lightning: reusable cardinal connected-ground conduction; Chain retains printed jump reach; Stormcoal Fire is consumed
board_surfaces.score_policy: bounded expected contact and useful geometry, with setup availability and fuel opportunity cost
